mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (as a continuous variable) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days because it signals a strong labor market and robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals that the Federal Reserve has completed its tightening cycle and is likely to pause or cut rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is above its 1-year moving average and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, it signals a strong economy with low unemployment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (GDPC1 above 1-year MA and UNRATE < 4.5) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a CPIAUCSL value above 202.0 signals that inflation is accelerating, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy further, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 202.0 and the regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) level (as a continuous variable) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days because it signals strong economic activity and corporate demand for goods, supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1800, it signals an overheating housing market and potential bubble, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 135000 and unemployment (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (PAYEMS > 135000 AND UNRATE < 4.5) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.
